Documentation passages:

[data-5] Audit logs
Audit logs are available only on the Business plan and are kept for 1 year.

[data-1] Active workspaces
Workspace data is kept for as long as the subscription is active.

[pricing-1] Plans and seats
Brightwell Cloud has three plans, billed per workspace. Starter costs $19 per month and allows up to 3 users. Team costs $49 per month and includes 10 users; each additional user on Team costs $6 per user per month. Business costs $199 per month and includes 25 users, single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.

[refunds-4] Add-ons
Usage-based add-ons, such as extra API calls and SMS credits, are not refunded once they have been consumed.

Customer question: Which plans include audit logs, and how long are they kept?

data.answer: Only the Business plan includes audit logs. The Starter and Team plans don't. Audit logs are kept for 1 year. The Business plan costs $199 per month and also includes 25 users and single sign-on (SSO).
